snippet.title: We're trying something new...
snippet.description: Veritasium's mission has always been to get to the truth - to understand how and why things work the way they do. We love the variety of topics we're able to cover - from the real to the abstract - and the heart of that is always hard science. But as our world is getting more complex and interesting, the team keep finding incredible stories that don't quite fit on the main channel. Stories that are less about physics and maths and more about how our society and global systems work; how a change on one side of the world can ripple through society affecting how you and I live our lives. So some of the team have been working on a new channel about just that. This is @InGeniusOfficial - an element of innovation. Hosted by Latif Nasser First video out now -

snippet.title: It's impossible to choose a number at random
